headline: Investors Withdraw Billions From Binance Following Record $6.3 Billion Hack
summary: Investors pulled $3.6 billion from cryptocurrency exchange Binance as the platform began allowing withdrawals following a record $6.3 billion theft from customer accounts.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, and major security breaches or liquidity outflows can impact broader digital asset market confidence and trading volumes.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: A massive security hack and subsequent heavy customer withdrawals directly impact the exchange's operations and capital reserves.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A record theft of $6.3 billion severely undermines confidence in the platform, prompting panic withdrawals and immediate liquidity pressures as billions in funds are pulled out.
